answer: Reference approach for API Client: define the contract, implement the behavior in small methods, validate assumptions, and test normal and edge cases. Build an HTTP client that checks status, uses a timeout/cancellation token, deserializes JSON, and handles expected failures. Tokens that must appear in one implementation: HttpClient, JsonSerializer, CancellationToken. Full code should be reviewed and compiled against .NET 10 before publication.
